{{Otheruses|Totem}}
{{Quote| We believe that the power of life focuses in the objects we surround ourselves with. Either inadvertently or intentionally, the things we gather reinforce who we are, making us stronger or, at times, weaker. In a balanced life, the internal and external worlds reflect each other perfectly. When a life is imbalanced, internal and external aspects must be adjusted accordingly.|Arrizza|<ref name="FH2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>}}
A '''life trinket'''<ref name="RESB">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> or '''totem''' was a small object used for religious purposes by [[Kurtzen]], the indigenous [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. They were typically carried in pouches by individual Kurtzen.<ref name="TABSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> The species held that they could focus the energies of life into such life trinkets. Such totems were also used in healing ceremonies by [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]]<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> and other Kurtzen. For instance, the Kurtzen [[Arrizza]] used a totem in an attempt to heal the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]].<ref name="FH2" />
